Subject: FY28 planning sprint: targets, scenarios & budget playbook

Team —

We need to kick off FY28 planning with a narrow, timeboxed sprint to land target ranges and three budget scenarios (base / upside / downside) that we can share at the QBR and with the Board prep group. Goals for this thread:

- Align on target owners and inputs by Friday 12/10.
- Populate the FY28_Planning_Template.xlsx with top-line revenue, ARR churn, modeled spend buckets (infra, R&D, GTM), and headcount assumptions.
- Produce two short artifacts by 12/17: targets snapshot + scenario playbook (1 pager each).

Owners:
- Revenue & GTM targets: Vivek
- Cost & ops scenarios: Laura
- Headcount / org planning: Tessa

Please find an initial template attached. Fill your tabs with assumptions and add brief notes where you are uncertain. I'll consolidate on Monday 12/13 and run an exec readout draft the following week.

Immediate asks:
1) Confirm ownership and whether you need an intro call with Finance (cc'd Rishi)
2) Block 90 minutes on your calendars for a working kickoff — proposed: Thu 12/10 10:00–11:30 PT (calendar link below)

Attachment: FY28_Planning_Template.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B-FY28-Playbook

Thanks — quick cadence on this will make the QBR prep painless.

—
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategy & Planning | Redwood Inference
